layers.title: Polymer mix
layers.description: Each sample's polymer mix placed by PCA. The 7 polymers with the longest lines (labelled) set the colors, evenly spaced around the wheel; thin gray lines are the other polymers. A watershed takes the color where its sample lands; grayer means closer to the average mix.

layers.title: Land cover (whole watershed)
layers.description: ESA WorldCover 2021 shares over the whole catchment. Color: agricultural / urban / wilderness mix (wilderness ≥ 85% shown).

legend.label: 01 · Snake River (above Boise & Owyhee): ag 11.7% · urban 0.4%

layers.title: Land cover along connected streams
layers.description: WorldCover inside stream buffers (500 m at the sample site to 100 m upstream), weighted by how much of the year each stream is connected to the sample site: a 0–1 score, not a share of land.

legend.label: 01 · Snake River (above Boise & Owyhee): ag 0.099 · urban 0.006

layers.title: Contribution to the sink
layers.description: Modelled share of the Snake below Weiser (sink) microplastics from each source (polymer-type mixture model, optimised best fit). Click a watershed for its bootstrap range.

layers.title: Likeness to the sink
layers.description: How closely each source's polymer mix matches the sink's on its own (likeness: 1 minus half the summed difference in polymer shares; 1 = identical). The mixture model's best blend of all six reaches 0.894.

layers.title: Streams connected on sampling day
layers.description: Share of each catchment's stream length likely flowing and connected to its sample site on 6 July (median year; PROSPER streamflow permanence + seasonal flow timing).

layers.title: Timing of peak flow
layers.description: Median-year peak of daily flow at unregulated gauges in each catchment (2004–2016; Malheur 1960–1994).
